_meta.note: BEHAVIOR-SPEC section 6.3 (CCRM-100 (Vs Pace Display), CCRM-97 (Pace Number)): the distance from the pace mark as numbers. Promoted from spec/mobile on 2026-11-02 at the desktop family's request: two installs must agree. Generated from the same inputs as spec/mobile/fixtures/display/cases.json, whose strings are the mobile wording of these numbers. expected null = no distance (spent, no reset clock or no reading). markTime (section 6.3, Robin 2026-11-02): the instant the pace mark equals the usage — window start + used/100 x length — as a future instant when over pace and a past duration when under; null = no readout.

vsPace.name: under the mark
vsPace.why: floor(60 - 50) = +10 (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

vsPace.name: over the mark
vsPace.why: floor(60 - 80) = -20, printed with U+2212 (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

vsPace.name: rounded down: room is never overstated
vsPace.why: floor(10.5) = 10 (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

vsPace.name: rounded down over the mark
vsPace.why: floor(-0.2) = -1 (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

vsPace.name: exactly on the mark
vsPace.why: no sign on zero (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

vsPace.name: first hours of a window
vsPace.why: floor(1.3) = 1 (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

vsPace.name: week spent falls back to usage
vsPace.why: the usage figure, as Used mode (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

vsPace.name: spent threshold 99.5
vsPace.why: usedPct >= 99.5 is spent: the usage figure, truncated as Used mode (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

vsPace.name: no reset clock falls back to usage
vsPace.why: window not started: no pace mark (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

vsPace.name: no reading
vsPace.why: an em dash, as every mode (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

vsPace.name: binary float edge: 2.3 - 0.3
vsPace.why: 2.3 - 0.3 is 1.9999999999999998 in binary floats; floor after adding 1e-9 gives +2 (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

vsPace.name: binary float edge on the mark
vsPace.why: (1 - 0.83) x 100 against an even 17: 0%, not -1% (null = the surface falls back to the usage figure, or a dash with no reading)

markDistance.name: under by less than 1 is on it
vs pace: the caption carries the usage

markTime.name: over pace: when the mark catches up
markTime.why: 52% used with 38.9% of the week gone: the mark reaches 52% later; the readout is that instant

markTime.name: under pace: how long ago the mark passed this usage
markTime.why: 50% used with 67% gone: the mark was at 50% this long ago
